desc: BFS brute force implemented and hypothesis verified against BFS for small N.
Efficient solver implemented (parity-consistent partition feasibility via greedy check + Lb shortcut).
Exhaustive N<=9 all-pairs + random N=10..14 independent BFS diff to confirm exact minimum counts and the Lb / Lb+1 / -1 trichotomy.
Adversarial stress for the greedy boundary scan: near-degenerate inputs (m=k, huge spans, many equal gaps, mixed-parity frozen boundaries) vs brute force/alternative DP.
Benchmark worst-case runtime (single N=1e6 dense feasible; T=2e5 tiny summing to 1e6) and confirm within time limit.
